messages:
nina: heads up — saw a spike in dropped trace-parent links for async jobs this morning when we ramped batching on gateway. dashboards show lots of orphaned leaf spans.
alex: ugh. visible in the request waterfall? any common path (sqs vs kafka)?
nina: mostly SQS delayed queue. looks like headers getting trimmed. example header we saw: `x-rw-trace:eyJwIjoibWFpbiIsInAiOjEwMiwicCI6eyJpZCI6IjEyMyJ9fQ==` — base64 sometimes > 8kb when we attach extra attrs from the gateway.
sam: SQS has header size limits across brokers, and some libs serialize into attributes which inflate quickly. We need a minimal envelope format.
irene: propose we move to a two-tier approach: minimal inline context in headers (trace id, parent id, flags, sampling) + optional payload in message body (`.trace.envelope`) for larger attrs. Body can be JSON with TTL and bounded size.
ryan: how would that interact with OTLP exporters and retention? If we dump attrs in body but exporters only export spans at processing time, we might lose link if processor drops attributes post-retention.
observability-bot: note: current OTLP pipeline drops non-span attrs older than 30d by default. retention policy: spans 90d, attrs 30d.
alex: that's a problem. If we store rich attrs in a sidecar payload that only gets attached to spans later (worker), and attr retention is shorter, dashboards will show incomplete metadata after 30d even if span exists for 90d.
nina: good catch. options: (A) change retention for span attributes to match spans (bumps storage cost), (B) keep minimal attrs inline only (smaller loss of context), (C) store full attrs in long-term blob store and reference via id from span.
sam: (C) i like — store JSON blobs in s3 with content-addressable id, put `x-rw-trace-ref: s3://tracedata/abcdef` in header. workers can fetch on enrich. Dashboards can lazily fetch referenced blobs for UI, but exporters must also resolve when reconstructing traces for ingestion.
irene: that requires exporter changes to dereference during export, and a TTL for blobs to match span retention. Also need auth for private customers on private deployments.
ryan: rollout UX question: we can't flip this for everyone. suggest feature-flag `queue-trace-enrichment` with three modes: off (current), ref-only (header reference to blob), enrich (inline minimal + ref). then canary to 5% of traffic on dedicated infra, monitor orphan rate and dashboard completeness metric.
alex: add metric: trace-link-rate = traces with parent link / total async traces. baseline now ~78%. target >98% after rollout.
observability-bot: @nina created ticket INF-4723: implement queue enrichment reference path. Deploy bot will post updates.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary toggles to 5% at 2026-03-22T02:00Z if INF-4723 ready.
ryan: implementation notes for engineers: 1) define minimal header schema (v1) — keep under 2kb. 2) use compressed JSON for blob with metadata: schema_version, created_ts, provenance. 3) exporter change — when ingesting spans, if ref header present, fetch blob async with bounded timeout; if fetch fails, attach placeholder tag `rw.trace.enrich_failed` so dashboards show partial.
sam: also need to ensure message queue retention supports blob fetch window. SQS visibility could delay worker > 5m; ensure blobs have >= 7d retention by default.
irene: docs/console UX: show an icon on trace waterfall when enriched attrs were loaded from blob (hover shows reference id). For policy UI, add toggle to set default enrichment mode per-team.
nina: nice. one more: security review — we must sign blobs and allow KMS decryption only at worker side for private deployments.
alex: ok next steps: RFC with schema + rollout plan. can someone write up quick proposal with sample header and blob JSON? @sam can you draft by EOD?
sam: yeah I'll draft and link INF-4723, include sample code:
``` 
// header example (v1)
{
  "trace_id":"0123456789abcdef",
  "parent_id":"abcdef012345",
  "sampled":1,
  "ref":"s3://tracedata/sha256:abcdef...",
  "v":1
}

// blob JSON
{
  "schema": "rw.trace.enrich.v1",
  "created":"2026-03-21T18:00:00Z",
  "attrs": {"http.user_agent":"...", "route":"/api/generate"},
  "origin":"gateway-3a" 
}
```
nina: perfect. thanks everyone. I'll track RFC and coordinate with security.
ryan: will add dashboard metric and alert for trace-link-rate drop during canary.
observability-bot: note: INF-4723 updated by sam at 1977770123.
nina: closing the thread — will ping once RFC is up. :thumbsup:
